## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/time-picker`.

### `TimePickerComponent`

**Selector:** `mona-time-picker`  
**Implements:** `FormValueControl<Date \| null>`  
**API reference:** [`TimePickerComponent`](/api/time-picker/TimePickerComponent)

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | `""` | Id of an element that describes the input, such as a hint or an error message. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `""` | Accessible name of the input. Prefer a visible label, linked through `inputId` or `aria-labelledby`; the placeholder is not a label. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` | `""` | Id of the element that labels the input. |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | Extra classes for the input's container. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the disabled state of the time picker. |
| `format` | `string \| null` | `null` | Sets the format of the time picker. If not specified, derives from the active locale, hourFormat, and showSeconds. Typed text is also accepted with one-digit hours, minutes and seconds. |
| `hourFormat` | `HourFormat \| null` | `null` | Sets the hour format of the time picker. When null, the active locale's clock is used: 12-hour for en-US, 24-hour for de-DE. |
| `hourStep` | `number` | `1` | Sets the hour step of the time picker. |
| `inputId` | `string` | `generated` | Id of the inner `<input>` element. Point a `<label for>` or `<mona-label for>` at it to label the time picker. A unique id is generated when it isn't set. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the time picker as invalid. When bound to a signal form field via `[formField]`, this is written by the `FormField` directive. |
| `max` | `Date \| undefined` | `undefined` | Sets the latest time of the time picker. Only the time of day is compared; a later typed time is reported as a `maxDate` error. |
| `min` | `Date \| undefined` | `undefined` | Sets the earliest time of the time picker. Only the time of day is compared; an earlier typed time is reported as a `minDate` error. |
| `minuteStep` | `number` | `1` | Sets the minute step of the time picker. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `""` | Sets the placeholder of the time picker. |
| `popupClass` | `string` | `""` | Sets the class of the popup element. |
| `popupHeight` | `ListSizeInputType` | `undefined` | Sets the height of the popup element. When not set, the popup fits the time selector. |
| `popupWidth` | `ListSizeInputType` | `undefined` | Sets the width of the popup element. When not set, the popup fits the time selector. |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the readonly state of the time picker. |
| `readonlyInput` | `boolean` | `false` | When true, the input is readonly but the popup button remains enabled. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the required state of the time picker. When bound to a signal form field via `[formField]`, this is written by the `FormField` directive. |
| `rounded` | `"full" \| "large" \| "medium" \| "none" \| "small"` | `"medium"` | Sets the border radius of the time picker. |
| `secondStep` | `number` | `1` | Sets the second step of the time picker. |
| `showClearButton` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the visibility of the clear button. Clearing empties the value at once. |
| `showSeconds` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the visibility of the second selector. |
| `size` | `"large" \| "medium" \| "small"` | `"medium"` | Sets the size of the time picker. |
| `touched` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the touched state of the time picker. When bound to a signal form field via `[formField]`, this is written by the `FormField` directive. |
| `value` (two-way) | `Date \| null` | `null` | Two-way bindable current time value. Typed text is written on Enter and when the input loses focus, on the current value's day (today when empty); text that isn't a valid time keeps the previous value and marks the field invalid. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | `PopupCloseEvent<unknown>` | Emits when the popup is about to close. This event is preventable. |
| `closed` | `void` | Emits after the popup is closed. |
| `open` | `PreventableEvent<Event>` | Emits when the popup is about to open. This event is preventable. |
| `opened` | `void` | Emits after the popup is opened. |
| `touch` | `void` | Emitted when focus leaves the time picker and its popup. The `FormField` directive listens to this to mark the field as touched. |
| `valueChange` | `Date \| null` | Emitted when `value` changes. |

#### Methods

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void` | Focuses the input and places the caret after the text. Read-only pickers take focus too. |
